A type of <c:ffff00>{{field}}<c> where a <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c> is held. {{terrain|cap}}
deep enough to submerge the whole body in water.

Only <c:ffff00>{{medabot|pl}}<c> with the <c:ffff00>{{submarine}}<c> <c:ffff00>{{leg_type}}<c> can join
the {{robattle}}. Others, and <c:ffff00>destroyed<c> ones, sink and
are immediately <c:ffff00>{{knocked_out}}<c>.

Because of <c:ffff00>{{terrain_affinity}}<c>, {{submarine}} <c:ffff00>{{mobility}}<c>,
<c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c> get +6.
